input.quote: 9. TRUELINK WARRANTIES. TrueLink represents and warrants that the Interface and all related software (i) is designed to be used before, on and after January l, 2000;
input.rationale: Section 9 is the only TrueLink warranty and it covers Year 2000 date handling alone. There is no professional/workmanlike warranty for the Hosting or Support Services, no conformance-to-documentation warranty for the Interface, software or deliverables, no malicious-code or compliance-with-laws warranty, and no repair/replacement/refund remedy. Section 3's hosting obligations are only "reasonable commercial efforts" undertakings, and Section 3(i) disclaims any warranty as to transmitted data, so the Agreement falls short of even the fallback. We therefore insert the preferred performance warranty (professional and workmanlike services with a 90-day services conformance period, 12-month conformance to documentation for software and deliverables, no malicious code, compliance with laws) plus the repair, replacement or refund remedy. The disclaimer at p0076 is already carved back by "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT", so no change is needed there.

ops.text: TrueLink further represents and warrants that: (i) the Hosting Services and Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner and, for a period of ninety (90) days following performance, will conform to their documentation; (ii) for a period of twelve (12) months following delivery, the Interface, all related software and all deliverables will conform to their documentation; (iii) the Interface and all related software will be free of viruses, worms, Trojan horses and other malicious code; and (iv) TrueLink will comply with all laws applicable to its performance under this Agreement. Client's remedy for breach of the foregoing warranties is repair, replacement or refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming services, Interface, software or deliverables.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 warrants only Year 2000 date handling, so TrueLink gives no warranty that the Interface conforms to its documentation or that the Hosting and Support Services will be competently performed. We have added our standard performance warranty (professional and workmanlike services with a 90-day services conformance period, 12-month software/deliverable conformance to documentation, no malicious code, compliance with laws) with a repair, replacement or refund remedy.
proposal.summary: Add a TrueLink performance and conformance warranty with repair/replacement/refund remedy to Section 9
